## Summary

### Full-Stack Engineering Intern — NeuraMach AI Studios
*Jan 2026 – Apr 2026 | Pune, India*

- Built abuse-resistant API submission pipelines with rate limiting and secure HLS video delivery with CloudFront signed cookies.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Direct Answers)

Q: Who is Pratham Shah?
A: Pratham Shah is a Full Stack Developer and Cloud Engineer based in Pune, India. He currently works as a Cloud Security Reliability Engineer Intern at Searce Inc., specializing in GCP FinOps, serverless backend architectures (AWS & GCP), React, Next.js, Node.js, and BCI signal processing.

Q: What experience does Pratham Shah have in Cloud Engineering and FinOps?
A: At Searce Inc., Pratham Shah conducts FinOps cost analytics, rightsizes Google Cloud Platform (GCP) resources, and analyzes infrastructure spend to balance cost efficiency, performance, and workload reliability.

Q: What serverless backend architecture experience does Pratham Shah have?
A: At NeuraMach AI Studios, Pratham Shah re-architected backend infrastructure to an AWS serverless REST stack using API Gateway, Node.js Lambda handlers, DynamoDB, SES, S3, and CloudFront with signed cookies, reducing deployment failures by 40%.

Q: What is the BCI NeuroArm project?
A: Built at IS360 Technologies, NeuroArm is an EEG signal processing pipeline and ML classifier (TensorFlow, Scikit-learn) that maps brain signal movement intent (left vs right arm) into real-time motor outputs.
